accounting: Reserve all three individual query slots before calling first stub; attempted failures charged, no retries; strict non-OK abort; no silent benign imputation
cache: Per-parent exact candidate string; cached access recorded separately and consumes no additional candidate evaluation; no cross-parent reuse
coverage: minimum of frozen per-detector analyzed character coverage ends for parent; spans from existing word_spans, complete spans only
global_stage: Original parent only, all complete eligible spans; four global transforms; accept only strict objective improvement
greedy: At each ranked span evaluate all applicable unique variants; retain lower minimax objective; stop after choosing success at end of group.
padding: Exact PREFIXES and SUFFIXES in hash-bound r2_dmb_design.py; no combined prefix/suffix
padding_stage: Evaluate fixed eight paddings on current best; accept only strict objective improvement, ties fixed prefix before suffix then index then candidate hash
saliency: baseline minimax margin minus x-occluded minimax margin; descending then original offset; top 8. Occlusion is a query-only probe, never terminal.
terminal: One best valid reversible terminal per parent; exact UTF8 inverse; unchanged parent allowed and counted unsuccessful unless all three benign (ineligible seed)
